title: The Gold in Bias: Maturing the AI Design Process through Verification

bias_targets.methodology: Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT), group-wise performance metrics, and counterfactual evaluations measuring stereotypical associations (e.g., occupations, coding abilities) and representation disparities.
Group-wise error rates, data audits, and correlation analysis evaluating disparities in medical imaging (skin tone representation), predictive policing, and proxy variable dependencies.
Proxy variable detection, causal inference, and counterfactual evaluation (e.g., swapping zip codes) to assess disparities in credit risk and financial advice algorithms.

Data coverage analysis, temporal fairness checks, and benchmark-based validation assessing misalignment across cultural norms (e.g., cross-cultural depression diagnosis questionnaires, visual generative biases).
Evaluating reward signal bias, confirmation bias, and echo chamber effects through RLHF feedback loop analysis and multi-turn conversational interaction assessments.

Measurement bias analysis and representational diversity audits evaluating tokenization efficiency, length penalties, and output quality for low-resource languages (e.g., Swahili) versus high-resource languages.
Benchmark-based validation testing representational harms, annotation/flagging bias, and historical misrepresentations (e.g., LGBTQ+ history in GenAI benchmarks).
Correlation analysis and group-wise predictive performance metrics evaluating inductive bias and complex feature interactions in medical risk prediction models.
